Top 10 TMJ Specialists in India For TMD Treatment

March 12, 2026March 12, 2026byDr Dilip Dental CentreTMJ Specialist

Are you looking for the best and certified TMJ specialist in India? Then no further than Prof Dr Dhivya Dilipkumar who has 15 years of experience in TMJ treatment.

Temporomandibular joint (TMJ) treatment is a highly specialised and focused treatment in the field of dentistry. Getting effective treatment for the same requires hands-on knowledge of the top 10 TMJ specialists in India, along with baseline awareness of what the TMJ is and its function. Read on to learn more about the country’s top TMJ specialists and where to consult with them for world-class dental procedures.

The Best TMJ Specialists in India: What They Do

The temporomandibular joint (TMJ) is an integral part of your face’s musculoskeletal structure. It is the joint that enables the smooth opening and closing of your jaws, connecting your lower mandible to your skull. Therefore, it plays a crucial role in eating and speaking. 

TMJ specialists in India provide dedicated diagnosis and treatment for a host of temporomandibular dysfunctions (TMD). Owing to its nature as a niche field, TMJ specialists have years of experience in identifying the root causes of TMJ dysfunction. Their dental expertise in this field extends to tried-and-tested exercises for TMJ pain relief as well as surgical methods (such as splint placement) to resolve the issue in the long term. 

The TMJ specialists featured in this list all have an extensive range of medical accreditations and qualifications across premier institutions in India and beyond. However, before getting into the list of specialists, let’s take a closer look at the nuances a TMJ specialist can provide over a general dentist.

Why Choose a TMJ Specialist in India?

  • Accurate Identification: Some of TMD’s symptoms closely resemble that of other orofacial conditions such as sinusitis. A TMJ specialist can help pinpoint the incidence of TMJ dysfunction with accurate diagnosis. 
  • Effective Treatment: Proper treatment of TMD requires a holistic approach that takes into consideration various factors such as the severity of symptoms and disorder progression. A TMJ specialist will provide 360-degree treatment for long-term recovery from TMD.
  • Attention to pain factor and comfort: In some minor cases, a TMJ specialist in India will recommend targeted physiotherapy to alleviate the symptoms of TMD, placing your comfort foremost for hassle-free treatment.

The above attributes hint at the innate complexity of TMJ conditions, and the care required to treat them in the long run. To that end, let’s shed some light on the intricacies of the TMJ, the risk factors for TMD, and telltale signs of TMJ dysfunction.

TMJ In Focus: Risk Factors & Symptoms

TMJ issues revolve around the temporomandibular joint as well as the muscles and ligaments that surround it. Therefore, TMJ disorders are considered a spectrum, with multiple possible causes. Currently, there are over 30 conditions that are known to affect the TMJ region. 

If left unchecked, TMJ disorders can lead to long-term chronic conditions that typically worsen over time. Some of these include:

  • Grinding of teeth
  • Jaw trauma
  • Tenderness in the temporomandibular joint

TMJ issues can be further categorised into the specific part of the framework that causes issues. For instance, the TMD could be caused by a displaced disc or a strained muscle. The best TMJ specialists in India are well-equipped to treat these conditions, with thorough diagnosis and focused treatment plans. 

To better understand what TMJ disorders can look like at the onset, here is a quick reference list of risk factors that the top 10 TMJ specialists in India typically advise patients on:

Risk factors:

  • Stress
  • Severe trauma in the jaw
  • Genetics
  • Lower pain tolerance
  • Stress in facial muscles
  • Habits (frequent clenching of the jaw)

What does TMD look like?

  • Clicking/popping in the jaw region
  • Pain during chewing/speaking
  • Chronic ear pain
  • Pain in the area around your eyes
  • A feeling of tightness in the head/temples
  • Jaw locking at the joint region

It is important to note that in most TMD cases, not all these symptoms may occur in a single instance. In a broad sense, the two general symptoms of TMJ disorders are joint locking (with ensuing sounds), and jaw pain of varying degrees.

Treatment for TMJ conditions typically depends on the causative factors and the specific site of the issue. Your TMJ specialist in India will prescribe treatment based on comprehensive factors such as your medical history and response to previous dental treatments. Some of the specific treatment methods for TMJ disorders are:

– Physiotherapy: Minor cases of TMJ disorders often subside after dedicated physiotherapy treatment in the affected region. This is especially true in cases where muscle strain is the root cause.

– Disc displacement treatment: If the disc in the temporomandibular joint is under slight displacement, splints may be used. In more severe cases, however, a surgical procedure known as arthrocentesis may be required.

– Trigger point injections: A highly specialised and niche treatment performed only by the most qualified TMJ specialists in India. Prof. Dr. Dhivya Dilipkumar is among the few TMJ specialists in the country qualified to perform this intricate procedure.

With this general overview of TMJ conditions, symptoms, and treatment covered, let’s go over the best TMJ specialists in India, where they currently serve, their expertise, and more.

With 15 years of experience Prof Dr Dhivya Dilipkumar is one the best TMJ specialist in India with a mastership in orofacial pain from Roseman University of Health Sciences, USA

Can temporomandibular dysfunction be cured on its own?

In minor TMJ cases, there are no apparent symptoms and it presents only a mild inconvenience. However, it is best to consult a top TMJ specialist in India to rule out aggravation of the condition over time.

Does TMJ treatment come under dentistry or cosmetic surgery?

Depending on the causative factor, TMJ treatment can potentially be classified both as dental as well as cosmetic. Specialisation in TMJ treatment in India helps elucidate the complexities of this condition.

What are some treatments for TMD?

Your TMJ specialist in India will prescribe treatment based on factors such as the severity of the dysfunction. Treatments include physiotherapy and splint implant.
